objective: Near the end of the build, reconcile every historical blocked task that does not require owner action. Distinguish superseded/resolved historical failures from genuinely unfinished recoverable work, complete any remaining bounded engineering gap, and ensure no non-owner recoverable blocker is silently left behind before whole-company acceptance.
prerequisites: Current high-priority v1 engineering queue should reach truthful terminal states first.
agent-company-watch-recovery-final-pass-2026-09-24 should be completed or blocked with fresh evidence.
Do not rerun provider-key/Stage-2 tasks while the seven owner-local credentials are unchanged.
allowed_scope: Audit every file in remote-queue/blocked/ against current main, completed successors, evidence, and current pending/running tasks.
Classify each blocked record as: superseded/resolved by verified successor evidence; deterministic owner/external blocker; or unresolved recoverable engineering work.

For superseded/resolved records, preserve them as historical evidence and document the successor/evidence that makes a rerun unnecessary. Do not rerun old broad tasks merely because the old record still says blocked.

For deterministic owner/external blockers (credentials, required owner approval, architecture choice, irreversible action, unchanged provider blocker), leave them parked and add only a concise owner TODO if still relevant.

For unresolved recoverable engineering work that needs no owner action, inspect partial work first and complete the smallest unfinished unit directly. If it cannot safely fit in this task, stage one unique bounded successor with no higher than medium priority and explicit resume evidence; never create duplicate retry chains.
Specifically verify historical queue-recovery/UTF-8/QuickEdit failures are superseded by the completed DeepSeek UTF-8 recovery and QuickEdit/two-retry hardening before deciding any rerun is needed.

Specifically verify historical E3 integration/rehearsal failures against completed production-execution, image-diagnosis, readiness-gate and later evidence; do not repeat real provider calls whose evidence is already sufficient.
Specifically verify Career Ops historical timeout against the completed company-registry/runtime audit and the tracker-writer/monthly-rollover task before deciding whether anything remains.
Run only bounded tests needed to close an identified gap; preserve landed commits/evidence, update state/tracker truthfully, and return strict terminal JSON.
stop_conditions: Do not requeue Stage-2 credential-gate retries while provider credential state is unchanged.
Do not redo superseded work or repeat expensive/live provider rehearsals without a concrete missing-evidence reason.
Do not perform owner-gated external mutations, deployment cutover, account actions, or secret handling.
No infinite retries; use the hardened bounded recovery policy.
notes: Pre-queue research found 12 historical blocked records. Most appear to be historical execution failures already superseded by later verified work: queue-isolation/live-recovery failures are covered by completed agent-live-queue-recovery-deepseek-utf8; E3 integration/truth and rehearsal failures have later production-execution/readiness evidence; Career Ops broad timeout preserved a committed 33-test interface and has a dedicated tracker-writer/monthly-rollover task pending; Stage-2 retry records are deterministic 0/7 credential blockers and must stay parked. Company Watch is the clearest unresolved recoverable block, so it has its own medium-priority recovery task immediately before this sweep. This task exists to verify that classification against live repo truth and catch any remaining non-owner gap before acceptance.
